claims: MLB.TV offers out-of-market game streaming for $149.99/year for the 2026 MLB season.
MLB.TV offers a single-team package for $59.99 for the 2026 MLB season.
MLB.TV has new integration into the ESPN App.
MLB.TV All Team Pass costs $149.99/year for the 2026 season.
MLB.TV All Team Pass provides access to every out-of-market game live and on-demand.
MLB.TV Single Team Pass costs $59.99/year for the 2026 season.
MLB.TV Single Team Pass allows streaming all games for one specific team out-of-market.
New for 2026, MLB.TV subscriptions are available through the ESPN app.
New users get a free one-month trial of ESPN Unlimited.
Eligible T-Mobile customers can claim a free 2026 MLB.TV subscription via the T-Life app starting March 24, 2026.
Live in-market games are generally not available on MLB.TV.
MLB.TV games are intended for viewers outside their local team's viewing area.
MLB.TV includes live audio.
MLB.TV includes archived games.
MLB.TV includes MLB Big Inning whip-around show.
MLB.TV includes condensed games.
MLB.TV is supported on smartphones, tablets, and connected devices through the MLB or ESPN app.
MLB.TV subscriptions can be managed and cancelled on MLB.com.
MLB.TV is available as a Prime Video channel for those subscribed via Amazon Prime.
Some local in-market blackout-free streams are available for the Padres, Phillies, Rays, Reds, Rockies, Royals, Twins, and Dodgers.
